identity.title: Add the ferforstart authority-injection session bootstrap

authorization.reference: Create a root CMD that injects .GOV/codex.yaml, .GOV/topology.yaml, and START_HERE.yaml as authority files; make AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md require it at session start; slug ferforstart.

lifecycle.next_action: No WP-019 action remains. Await separate Operator direction before activating another work packet.

scope.summary: Create a disk-agnostic Windows CMD session bootstrap that injects the three named canonical authority files into model-visible output and requires complete reading and acknowledgment before repository work.
in_scope: Create root ferforstart.cmd using repository-root discovery from the script path.
Fail closed when any required authority file is missing or unreadable.
Emit START_HERE.yaml, .GOV/codex.yaml, and .GOV/topology.yaml completely with stable boundaries and an exact acknowledgment instruction.
Add byte-identical FF-BOOT-007 startup rules to AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.
Register the launcher in repository topology and stable-ID governance.
non_goals: Change the substance or precedence of the injected authority files.
Add a model-vendor-specific CLI dependency or launch a model process.
Modify product code, runtime behavior, dependencies, packaging, or release state.
dependencies: START_HERE.yaml remains the model entrypoint authority.
.GOV/codex.yaml remains the canonical project rules authority.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Running ferforstart.cmd from the repository root and from another working directory exits 0, injects the complete contents of START_HERE.yaml, .GOV/codex.yaml, and .GOV/topology.yaml with unambiguous boundaries, and emits the required read-before-action acknowledgment contract.
evidence: Root and C:\Windows invocations both exited 0 and produced byte-identical output.
Bounded START_HERE.yaml, .GOV/codex.yaml, and .GOV/topology.yaml sections matched their canonical sources line-for-line; exact acknowledgment count was 1.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: ferforstart.cmd fails nonzero with a named error when any required authority file is unavailable and never emits a false completion acknowledgment.
evidence: Missing START_HERE.yaml, .GOV/codex.yaml, and .GOV/topology.yaml fixtures each exited 1, emitted zero stdout bytes, and named the unavailable file in a FERFORSTART-ERROR.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md remain byte-identical and contain FF-BOOT-007 requiring ferforstart.cmd at every session start, complete reading, acknowledgment, and compliance with all injected repository rules and instructions before acting.
evidence: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md SHA-256 hashes were identical.
FF-BOOT-007 occurred exactly once in each mirrored bootstrap router.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Repository topology and stable-ID registration identify ferforstart.cmd as the session authority injector and link it to all three injected authority surfaces.
evidence: FF-NODE-SESSION-BOOTSTRAP-001 and all three FF-EDGE-SESSION-BOOTSTRAP-INJECTS-* IDs are registered in .GOV/id-registry.yaml and represented in .GOV/topology.yaml.
